_comment: The scores GraphDog's own docs currently achieve, used by CI as a regression gate:
`npm run eval -- --baseline eval/baseline.json` fails if any of these falls by more
Trimmed to the five gated metrics on purpose. A full report from `--out` is also
accepted here, but it carries per-query latency, which differs on every machine and
would make this file churn on every run.
Raise these numbers when a change improves retrieval; lowering one is a decision that
belongs in a review, which is the whole point of checking the file in.
evidence_accuracy is conditional on retrieval: it only scores spans of documents that
were actually found, so it can fall when recall rises and more spans come under test.
Read it next to evidence_checked, never alone.
